question: Should OpenClaw ship this Discord subagent-progress UX, and should its terminal cleanup use the proposed public ChannelLifecycleAdapter subagentProgress contract or a narrower canonical lifecycle seam?
rationale: The implementation and proof do not decide whether seven new Discord controls and a specialized published lifecycle API are the long-term product and plugin contract maintainers want.

options.title: Narrow the lifecycle seam
options.body: Keep the Discord feature but route terminal cleanup through a generic existing/new subagent terminal contract or bundled-only Discord facade before merge.

options.title: Approve the proposed contract
options.body: Explicitly accept the new public channel lifecycle member and configuration namespace as supported plugin and operator API.

options.title: Decline the feature surface
options.body: Close or substantially reduce the PR if Discord source-message subagent progress is not a supported core product direction.

recommendation.title: Narrow the lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Keep the Discord feature but route terminal cleanup through a generic existing/new subagent terminal contract or bundled-only Discord facade before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The product behavior is Discord-specific, with agents/hooks owners needed to co-review the lifecycle API boundary.
